column3: The failure to pay interest when due on the outstanding subordinated class or classes of notes will not be an event of default. The failure to pay principal of a note generally will not result in an event of default until the applicable final scheduled distribution date or redemption date for the related class of notes. Only the holders of the outstanding controlling class will have rights to direct remedies under the indenture and the ability to waive events of servicing termination or to terminate the servicer.
